missing.what_was_said: Management expected North America to improve more gradually than previously anticipated because second-quarter performance was weaker than expected.

Despite improving snack volumes, PFNA organic revenue declined slightly in the third quarter. Its core operating margin declined 280 basis points, reflecting affordability investments, the comparison with a prior-year asset-sale gain, and higher advertising and marketing investments, partially offset by productivity savings and organic volume growth.
